messages:
maya: Quick sync — enterprise pilot asked for cross-region SOC2 evidence handoff and long-term retention options. Need to decide: retention windows per region, export format (signed manifests + proofs), and legal-hold behavior. Can ops support on-prem envelope export for customers?
sam: We can map tenants -> regions easily. main constraint is retention TTL + legal hold overrides. need concrete numbers.
oliver: From security POV: BYOK/KMS handshake required for customer-managed keys. For SOC2 we must preserve chain-of-custody; prefer signed manifests + Merkle root for batch exports.
priya: Legal flag — some customers request 7y EU retention. That may conflict with our data minimization policy unless explicitly contracted. Need opt-in clause.
maya: Proposal: default retention = 1y, enterprise opt-in add-on to 7y (contracted). export payload = gzipped archive + manifest.json signed by our signing key + merkle_root. prototype using cross-region S3 + signed manifest. Thoughts?
sam: Prototype feasible. Implementation tasks: 1) manifest schema 2) cold-export pipeline 3) legal_hold toggle + admin UI. will need Keystore API changes for escrow/BYOK. ETA: prototype in 3 sprints if no scope creep.
oliver: Also add ISO/ISO27001 control mapping for evidence fields. I'll draft SOC2 & ISO mapping doc (which fields map to CC6/CC7 etc).
maya: :thumbsup: good. include minimal runtime impact — use offline/export path so online latency not affected.
ops-bot: Created ticket TKT-7891: "cross-region-evidence-proto"; assignees: @sam, @oliver; due_date: 2024-07-19. Link: https://redwood.example/tickets/TKT-7891
sam: Added to eng backlog. note: prototype will write exports to customer-owned bucket when BYOK is enabled, otherwise to our staging bucket with escrow key.
priya: Confirming legal needs: opt-in contract addendum + residency appendix + explicit retention SLA. I can draft language after we lock retention tiers.
maya: I'll run a 30m kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PT. Agenda: scope, manifest spec, retention tiers (1y vs 7y), legalhooks (contract + UI), BYOK handshake, ops runbook. Please bring one decision point each.
oliver: I'll bring SOC2 mapping + suggested manifest fields.
sam: I'll bring rough implementation plan + perf/ops caveats.
priya: I'll bring contract template examples and risk notes.
maya: Thanks — we'll iterate the kickoff notes into the ticket.
